description: This file contains configuration check functions for Mattermost workspace security and setup, including SSL, session length, root user status, and file storage access, with an exported function to run all checks.

methods.name: ssl
methods.description: Checks if the current connection is over HTTPS.

methods.name: sessionLength
methods.description: Checks if the session length is set to the default of 720 hours.

methods.name: rootUserCheck
methods.description: Checks if Mattermost is running as root user.

methods.name: fileStorage
methods.description: Checks the status of file storage access.

methods.name: runConfigChecks
methods.description: Runs all configuration checks concurrently and returns their results.
